newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - USX-Marathon yr estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - USX-Marathon yr estimate raised.

text.p: Schroder & Co analyst Michael Mayer has raised his full year earnings forecast for USX-Marathon Group to $1.95 a share from $1.70.
-- Yesterday the company reported second quarter earnings of $0.55 a share, $0.05 above expectations.
-- Schroder initiated a 1998 earnings estimate of $2.30 a share, saying the company will benefit in that year from a 13 percent rise in production.
-- Mayer's estimate does not include any savings from the company's downstream venture with Ashland Inc, which could save $0.15-$0.40 per share when implemented.
